title: One event, from send to poll
description: The host hands dream-net an event id and bytes. They cross in a packet that many events share, inside an encrypted netcode datagram, and come out of the other host's poll with the sender attached.

nodes.title: send
nodes.detail: Checks the event and its size against the schema, and copies the bytes into its channel's queue before returning.

nodes.title: flush
nodes.detail: Packs events from every channel into packets sized to one datagram. reliable numbers and acknowledges them; netcode encrypts them and sends them over UDP.

nodes.title: poll
nodes.detail: On the other host, after its update: lifecycle records and events in arrival order, with the authenticated sender.

nodes.title: Schema
nodes.detail: Channels and events, frozen before networking starts. Both ends compare its fingerprint before any event is accepted.

nodes.title: TransportConfig
nodes.detail: Packet sizes, timers, and the byte budgets that bound every queue.
